strings.budget.help: List what fits in a USB packet at common rates
strings.budget_header: A USB packet holds %u bytes on this chip (%s speed, one packet every %u us)
strings.budget_open_hint: The open microphone runs at %u Hz.
strings.budget_raw_hint: The open microphone is undecimated and can be streamed at %u, %u, %u or %u Hz.
strings.budget_row: %7u Hz: up to %2u channel(s) at 16-bit, %2u at 24-bit
strings.config.help: Choose rate, channels and width, and check they fit the USB bandwidth
strings.config_fit_none: At %u Hz not even one channel fits.
strings.config_fit_rate: With %u channel(s), up to %u Hz fits.
strings.config_ok: %u channel(s) at %u Hz, %u-bit: %u of %u bytes per USB packet. OK
strings.config_over: %u channel(s) at %u Hz, %u-bit: needs %u bytes per USB packet but only %u fit
strings.config_start_next: Run 'audio-usb start' to present it to the USB host.
strings.group.help: Stream the open microphone to a USB host as a USB audio device
strings.no_usb_chip: This chip (%s) has no USB device controller
strings.start.help: Present the stream to the USB host (ends the serial console until reset)
strings.start_timeout: The device will reset after %u s so the serial console returns.
strings.start_warn: USB audio starts now. The serial console ends here and returns after a reset; use the web console to watch or stop it.
strings.started: Streaming %u channel(s) at %u Hz; waiting for the host to open the device
strings.status.help: Show the USB state, the stream and what it dropped
strings.status_counts: Sent %llu bytes, dropped %llu bytes, %u overrun(s), %u read error(s)
strings.status_decimator: Decimator: %.0f cycles per frame, %.1f%% of one core
strings.status_ended_errors: The stream stopped after repeated read errors. Run 'audio-usb stop' and start again.
strings.status_ended_gone: The stream stopped: the microphone was closed under it. Run 'audio-usb stop', reopen the microphone and start again.
strings.status_idle: Not streaming. Run 'audio-usb config' then 'audio-usb start'.
strings.status_running: Stream: %u channel(s), %u Hz, %u-bit; packet %u of %u bytes
strings.stop.help: Stop the stream and the USB device
strings.stopped: USB stream stopped. The serial console returns after a reset.
strings.timeout_invalid: timeout needs a number of seconds from 1 to 86400
